source.name: India VIIRS S-NPP historical observations, 2025
source.primary_source: NASA FIRMS / VIIRS S-NPP standard processing
notes: Downloaded from a pinned public mirror of a NASA-format FIRMS archive; direct NASA access is unavailable in this sandbox.
Mirror provenance is disclosed; bit-for-bit equivalence to the primary NASA country archive has not been verified.
NASA type is an algorithmic source-type label, not a verified incident report. Collection-2 type-field reprocessing status of the mirror is unverified.

selection: All valid source observations from the final seven calendar days; no spatial or class sampling.
history: Past-only 30-day features were computed from the full quarter before selecting this window.
training_overlap: Historical replay may contain training-region records. Use the separate model-card holdout metrics, not replay performance, for evaluation.
